about: Douglas L. Gordon is an attorney who represents clients in the Fresno, California area. Douglas Gordon is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2008 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Douglas Gordon chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of California College of the Law, San Francisco (formerly UC Hastings) and graduated in 1992. Douglas Gordon passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1993.

He represents clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues in California. He also represents clients with Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff and Employment Litigation: Plaintiff issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Douglas Gordon has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
